title: Debate a topic
description: Practise summarising news and arguing both sides.

items.targetText: According to the report, both sides have entered a fierce debate.
items.hint: According to the report is a news phrase

items.targetText: If the proposal is accepted, companies would need to reduce emissions.

items.prompt: Summarise a news headline and give your reaction in three sentences.
items.promptIt: Riassumi un titolo di giornale e dai la tua reazione in tre frasi.
items.exampleAnswer: The headline is about a new climate policy. According to the report, there is strong debate. In my view, the proposal is necessary but challenging.
items.hint: Use headline, according to, and in my view
